title: Scheme to Provide Assistance for Setting Up Farmer Support Centers in State Market Committees and for Computerization of All Market Committees

scheme.name: Scheme to Provide Assistance for Setting Up Farmer Support Centers in State Market Committees and for Computerization of All Market Committees
scheme.summary: The scheme aims to support farmers by setting up information centers and computerizing market committees for better efficiency and transparency.
eligibility: Market Committees of all areas of Gujarat State shall be eligible for this scheme.
exclusions: Individual farmers are not eligible. The scheme is specifically designed for market committees.
scheme.benefits: To create farmer support center: 50% of the cost incurred including manpower or a maximum of ₹2,00,000/-, whichever is less. For computerization: Assistance of up to 90% or ₹2,00,000/- for 'K' and 'D' categories on purchase of 2 computers, 2 printers, and software.
documents: Proposal document from the Market Committee.
Purchase details (if applying for hardware/software assistance).
Any other documents required by the authorities.
